title: Kiritani Haruka — You Deserve It〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I ended up coming here at our usual time anyway...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We all agreed to practice on our own this morning instead of gathering like always since we just had our show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning.
You came too, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You look sleepy. Are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Our show went really well yesterday, right? It made me so happy that I couldn't fall asleep last night...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that's why you look so tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah... But you're here too so...
*Yawn*... We should stretch...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori's about to fall asleep...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, would you mind doing something for me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm feeling a little tired too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'd be bad if we fell asleep during class, so what if we both took a little nap until Airi and Shizuku get here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhm, okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. Come sit next to me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, you can rest your head on my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhm, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um...
Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Our show went well yesterday, right?
It wasn't a dream...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It did. It went well and it wasn't a dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys really are amazing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm trying to learn everything that you and the others learned a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The butterflies you feel during a live show, that sense of satisfaction from when you're singing and dancing perfectly in sync, the power you receive from the fans cheering and applauding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've experienced all of that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this is the first time we've performed with someone like you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll experience a lot of firsts together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't... Wait...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sleep tight, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, she might catch a cold like this. I'd like to give her my jacket, but moving could wake her up...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I knew it! You are here!
Morning, Haruka... M-Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She's sound asleep.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Perfect timing. Could you drape that jacket there over Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This one? There you go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She's sleeping like a baby.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She really is. Apparently, she was so happy that our show went so well that she couldn't fall asleep yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I remember that feeling. I felt the same way after our first release event.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. We really do all go down the same paths, don't we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... We'll end up waking her if we start practicing. Maybe we should cancel practice for today and give ourselves a little break?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Maybe we should cancel our lunch practice as well and just do something light in the evening?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. That sounds fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's pretty bold of her to use the shoulder of the person she's idolized so much as a pillow, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know! We should take a picture as evidence this actually happened!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, but try not to wake her...
